描述你想看见的画面…: Describe what you want to create…
选择适合当前网络的下载源。: Choose a source that works with your connection.
两种来源提供同一模型。选择会被记住，之后可在模型设置中更改。: Both sources provide the same model. Your choice is saved and can be changed in Settings.
40 步适合正式出图，较少步数用于预览。: Use 40 steps for finished images and fewer steps for previews.
-1 表示随机，相同种子方便比较修改。: Use -1 for a random seed, or reuse a seed to compare changes.
删除会话会移除聊天记录，已保存的图片文件仍保留在本地。: Deleting a chat removes its messages. Saved image files stay on this device.
描述画面，或添加图片…: Describe an image, or add a reference…
最多添加 10 张参考图: You can add up to 10 reference images
对话模式不处理参考图，请切换到图像模式或移除图片: Switch to Image mode or remove the reference images to chat.
已加入队列，前一个任务完成后自动发送: Queued. This message will run after the current task.
请检查步数和种子的取值范围: Check the allowed range for steps and seed.
图片应小于 20 MB: Images must be smaller than 20 MB.
确定删除这个会话及其聊天记录？: Delete this chat and all its messages?
下载进行中，完成或中断后可更改下载源。: You can change the source after the download finishes or stops.
更改下载源不会重新下载已完成的模型。: Changing the source will not download a completed model again.
更换来源会保留已下载的分段，完成后校验文件。: Downloaded parts are kept when switching sources. Files are verified after downloading.
请从桌面应用打开: Open this from the desktop app.
轮换设置须为开关。: Welcome rotation must be on or off.
GPU 内存分配失败，图像生成已停止。请关闭其他占用内存的应用后重试，或选择较小: Image generation stopped because GPU memory could not be allocated. Close memory-intensive apps or choose a smaller image size, then try again.
图像生成进程意外退出。详细信息已保存在本地任务日志中。: Image generation stopped unexpectedly. Details are saved in the local task log.
聊天进程退出，请重试。: The chat process stopped. Try again.
参考图用于“图像”模式，请先切换模式。: Switch to Image mode to use reference images.
模型还未下载完成。请在“模型设置”中下载或查看进度。: The image model is not ready. Download it or check progress in Settings.
最多使用 10 张参考图。: You can use up to 10 reference images.
参考图不存在，请重新添加。: The reference image is missing. Add it again.
图片尺寸须为 256–2752 之间的 32 的倍数。: Image dimensions must be multiples of 32, between 256 and 2752.
图片总像素暂不超过约 430 万，请选择支持的 2K 尺寸。: Choose a supported 2K size, up to approximately 4.3 million pixels.
种子须为 -1 或 0–4294967295。: Seed must be -1 or between 0 and 4,294,967,295.
请选择已安装的本地聊天模型。: Choose an installed local chat model.
这个模型不支持所选思考设置。: This model does not support the selected thinking effort.
应用正在关闭，请重新打开后发送。: The app is closing. Reopen it before sending a message.
已有 10 条消息排队，请稍后再发送。: There are 10 messages in the queue. Wait before sending another.
任务已结束或程序已重启。: The task has ended or the app has restarted.
请先停止这个会话中的任务。: Stop this chat’s active task first.
文件过大，请使用小于 20 MB 的图片。: The file is too large. Use an image smaller than 20 MB.
图片应小于 20 MB。: Images must be smaller than 20 MB.
图片请限制在 2500 万像素以内。: Images must be no larger than 25 million pixels.
已有下载任务正在运行，请勿同时切换下载源。: A download is running. Wait before changing its source.
未检测到 GPU 加速，请检查 PyTorch 环境。: GPU acceleration is unavailable. Check the PyTorch environment.
模型没有返回正文，请重试或更换聊天模型。: The model returned no text. Try again or choose another chat model.
下载中断。点击继续下载可重试；已完成的分段会保留。详情见本地目录的 downlo: Download interrupted. Select Resume download to retry; completed parts are kept. See download.log in the data folder for details.
下载源未正确返回文件分段。请重试。: The source returned an invalid file segment. Try again.
分段下载暂时失败，请点击继续下载重试。: A file segment failed to download. Select Resume download to retry.
检测本机环境，准备开始创作。: Check this device before you start creating.
首次使用需完成必需项目。模型文件可在进入后下载；Ollama 仅用于对话。: Complete the required checks before first use. Download image weights inside the app. Ollama is only needed for chat.
必需项目已通过，可以开始使用。: All required checks passed. You’re ready to start.
部分必需项目尚未通过，请按提示处理后重新检测。: Some required checks need attention. Follow the instructions, then check again.
可以保存会话与图片: Chats and images can be saved
需要 Apple Silicon 和 macOS 14 或更新版本。: Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later are required.
无法写入数据目录，请检查磁盘和权限。: The data folder is not writable. Check disk space and permissions.
未安装应用运行环境，请安装依赖。: The app runtime is missing. Install dependencies to continue.
检测超时，请重试或修复环境。: The check timed out. Retry or repair the environment.
无法加载，请安装或修复依赖。: Could not load this component. Install or repair dependencies.
依赖检查进程退出，请尝试修复环境。: The dependency check stopped. Try repairing the environment.
未找到 curl，请修复系统下载工具。: curl was not found. Repair the system download tool.
先在 Ollama 下载一个聊天模型；不影响生图。: Download a chat model in Ollama first. Image generation is available without it.
未连接 Ollama；不影响生图。: Ollama is not connected. Image generation is available without it.
当前 Diffusers 不支持所需的图像接口。: This Diffusers version does not support the required image pipeline.
未检测到可用的 Apple GPU。: No available Apple GPU was detected.
未检测到可用的 NVIDIA CUDA GPU。: No available NVIDIA CUDA GPU was detected.
当前显卡不支持模型所需的 BF16。: This GPU does not support the model’s required BF16 operations.
环境变化时，软件会重新进入此页面。: The app will return here if a required component becomes unavailable.
本地服务未能启动，请查看详细日志。: The local service could not start. See the detailed log.
本地服务已停止，正在重新检测环境。: The local service stopped. Checking the environment again.
安装结束，正在重新检测。: Installation finished. Checking the environment again.
安装未完成，请查看详细日志后重试。: Installation did not finish. See the detailed log, then try again.
环境修复前，请先停止正在执行和排队的任务。: Stop active and queued tasks before checking the environment.
缺少 WebView2，请安装后重新检测。: WebView2 is missing. Install it, then check again.
语言设置无法保存，请检查本地存储。: Language could not be saved. Check local storage.
先安装 Python，再点“安装或修复依赖”。: Install Python first, then select Install or repair dependencies.
环境缺失，排队任务已停止。: Queued tasks were stopped because a required component is unavailable.
推理进程退出。请在模型设置查看日志。: The image process stopped. Open the local logs from Settings for details.
官方默认值为 1。使用反向提示词时须大于 1；较高数值未必更好。: The official default is 1. Negative prompts need a value above 1; higher is not always better.
每行一段，请填写需要原样出现的文字。长篇文字建议拆成多张图。: Enter the exact wording, one passage per line. Split long text across several images.
依次生成，每张图片使用独立种子。: Generate one at a time, with a separate seed for each image.
补全画面细节并保留指定文字；原始提示词和实际提示词均可查看。: Expand scene details while preserving specified text. Both the original and effective prompts remain available.
在图片上圈选或涂抹修改区域: Circle or paint the areas to edit
根据任务自动使用生图或改图增强模型。每个模型约 18.8 GB，在图像生成前单独: The app selects the generation or editing enhancer for each task. Each model is about 18.8 GB and runs separately before image generation.
圈选或涂抹要修改的位置，再在对话框描述修改内容。: Circle or paint an area, then describe the changes in the composer.
例如：第二次世界大战\n1939 年：战争爆发:
For example: World War II
1939: War begins
当前文字编码接口与固定版本不一致，请修复环境。: The text encoder differs from the supported version. Repair the environment.
提示词增强须为开关。: Prompt enhancement must be on or off.
反向提示词请限制在 16000 字以内。: Limit the negative prompt to 16,000 characters.
提示词增强未返回唯一的画布比例，请重试。: The enhancer did not return a single canvas ratio. Please retry.
引导强度须为 1–10。: Guidance scale must be between 1 and 10.
增强器返回了不支持的画布比例。: The enhancer returned an unsupported canvas ratio.
提示词增强未返回完整结果，请重试。: The enhancer did not return a complete result. Please retry.
增强器返回了无效的参考图编号。: The enhancer returned an invalid reference number.
请选择有效的画布比例设置。: Choose a valid canvas ratio setting.
反向提示词需要同时设置大于 1 的引导强度。: Use a negative prompt together with a guidance scale above 1.
透明背景须为开关。: Transparent background must be on or off.
跟随参考图比例需要先添加图片。: Add a reference image before matching its ratio.
每次生成数量须为 1–4。: Generate between 1 and 4 images per task.
请先下载本次任务所需的提示词增强模型。: Download the prompt enhancer needed for this task first.
提示词增强模型缺少系统提示词，请重新下载。: The enhancer is missing its system prompt. Download the model again.
已选择 2K 和 40 步，请填写图中文字: Selected 2K and 40 steps. Enter the text to appear in the image.
使用 <image{mask}> 作为 <image{source}> 的蒙版，: Use <image{mask}> as a mask for <image{source}>. Edit the white areas and preserve the rest.
修改 <image{image}> 中红色标注的区域，最终图片不要保留标记。: Edit the red-marked areas in <image{image}>. Remove the marks from the final image.
桌面显示组件无法启动。请检查 WebView2 和数据目录权限后重新检测。: The desktop view could not start. Check WebView2 and data folder permissions, then run the checks again.
已下载的图像模型无需重下；提示词增强模型是额外权重。: Keep your existing image model. Prompt enhancers are additional downloads.
已找到 Python，但版本或架构不兼容。需要 64 位 Python 3.10: Python was found, but its version or architecture is incompatible. Use 64-bit Python 3.10–3.13.
指定的 Python 环境不可用，请检查 QWEN_STUDIO_PYTHON。: The selected Python environment is unavailable. Check QWEN_STUDIO_PYTHON.
Python 查找未能完成，请查看详细日志。: Python discovery could not finish. See the detailed log.
未找到可用的 Python。安装 64 位 Python 3.10–3.13 后: No working Python was found. Install 64-bit Python 3.10–3.13, then check again.
4 步蒸馏模型，适合草稿；复杂修改效果较弱: 4-step distilled model for drafts; weaker on complex edits
所有文件从 Hugging Face 固定版本下载，并逐个校验 SHA-256。: All files come from pinned Hugging Face revisions and are verified with SHA-256.
检查 Python、依赖、图像推理接口与 GPU。: Checks Python, dependencies, the image pipeline and the GPU.
补全画面细节并保留指定文字；原始提示词和实际提示词均可查看。本机上约需 1–3: Expands scene details while preserving specified text; the original and effective prompts stay visible. Takes about 1–3 minutes on this Mac.
2K 图像在本机上耗时约为 1K 的 6–7 倍，并需要更多内存。: On this Mac a 2K image takes about 6–7 times longer than 1K and needs more memory.
极速 4 步、标准 25 步、精细 40 步；手动修改后切换为自定义。: Turbo uses 4 steps, Standard 25, Quality 40; changing the value switches to custom.
-1 表示随机，相同种子方便比较修改。修改图片时请保持随机：相同种子和尺寸会得到: Use -1 for a random seed, or reuse a seed to compare changes. Keep it random when editing: the same seed and size return an almost identical image.
关闭参考图缓存：多张参考图时保留完整分辨率，但每一步都要重新计算，明显更慢。: Turns off the reference cache: several references keep full resolution, but every step recomputes them, which is much slower.
思考越长，增强越慢；本机约每秒 30 个标记。: Longer thinking is slower; this Mac produces about 30 tokens per second.
选择任务后，提示词会填入输入框，请把括号中的说明替换为你的内容。需要参考图的模板: Choose a task to fill in the prompt, then replace the text in parentheses with your own. Add reference images first for templates that need them.
圈选、框选或涂抹要修改的位置，再在对话框描述修改内容。不同颜色可以对应不同的修改: Circle, box or paint the areas to change, then describe the edits in the composer. Use different colors for different edits.
“增强提示词”生成图片时需要: Needed to enhance prompts for new images
“增强提示词”修改图片时需要: Needed to enhance prompts for edits
已选择精细模式和提示词增强，请填写图中文字: Quality mode and prompt enhancement are on. Enter the text to appear in the image.
生成带透明背景的 PNG（贴纸、图标、角色立绘）。: A PNG with a transparent background (stickers, icons, character art).
把照片中的主体抠出为透明 PNG。: Cut the subject out of a photo as a transparent PNG.
只保留指定物体，输出透明 PNG。: Keep only the chosen object, as a transparent PNG.
保留人物或商品，替换场景。: Keep the person or product, replace the scene.
商品外观、文字和材质保持一致。: Keeps the product's look, text and materials.
整体转换画风，保留构图。: Change the art style, keep the composition.
按第二张图的风格重绘第一张图。: Redraw the first image in the style of the second.
第一张为人物，其余为服饰。: First image: the person; the others: clothing.
第二张图提供面部身份。: The second image provides the face.
局部修改人物表情或动作。: Change a person's expression or gesture.
去除划痕、提高清晰度并自然上色。: Remove scratches, sharpen and colorize naturally.
向四周延展画面（使用更宽的画布）。: Extend the picture beyond its borders (wider canvas).
由一张照片生成 2:1 等距柱状全景。: Turn one photo into a 2:1 equirectangular panorama.
文字较多时建议开启提示词增强和精细模式。: For text-heavy images, turn on prompt enhancement and Quality mode.
文字编码结果无效，请重试。: The prompt encoding was invalid. Try again.
请选择要下载的模型。: Choose the model files to download.
极速模式不支持反向提示词和引导强度。: Turbo mode does not support negative prompts or guidance.
提示词增强模板未开启思考模式。: The enhancer template did not enable thinking.
极速 LoRA 基于官方权重训练，与无审查模型搭配时效果可能较差。: The Turbo LoRA was trained on the official weights; with the uncensored model its results may be worse.
可选，“增强提示词”生成图片时需要: Optional, enhances prompts for new images
